sessions.title: Intro to Classical ML
topics: Introduce supervised vs unsupervised learning and when each applies.
Walk through the end-to-end classical ML pipeline from data to evaluation.
Sketch a first sklearn workflow with a proper train/test split.

sessions.title: Data preparation for ML
topics: Cover train/test hygiene and common leakage patterns.
Apply encoding and scaling as preprocessing steps.
Compare strategies for missing values before modeling.

sessions.title: Linear Regression deep dive
topics: Go beyond the DA 101 intuition for linear regression.
Cover the hypothesis, cost function, and closed-form solution.
Introduce feature scaling basics needed for stable fitting.

sessions.title: Linear Regression assumptions
topics: State the classical linear regression assumptions and why each matters.
Diagnose violations using residual plots and simple checks.
Discuss practical remedies when assumptions fail in real data.

sessions.title: Gradient Descent
topics: Derive the gradient descent update rule and the role of learning rate.
Compare batch, mini-batch, and stochastic gradient descent.
Discuss practical pitfalls such as diverging loss and poor feature scaling.

sessions.title: Bias-Variance & Polynomial Regression
topics: Explain underfitting vs overfitting through the bias-variance tradeoff.
Use polynomial features to control model complexity.
Build intuition for learning curves as a diagnostic tool.

sessions.title: Regularization & Cross-Validation
topics: Introduce Ridge, Lasso, and Elastic Net regularization.
Apply k-fold cross-validation for reliable model assessment.
Practice hyperparameter selection with validation strategies.

sessions.title: Logistic Regression, Metrics & Imbalance
topics: Review logistic regression for binary classification.
Cover the confusion matrix along with precision, recall, F1, ROC, and AUC.
Study class imbalance, metric pitfalls, and threshold tuning for operating-point tradeoffs.

sessions.title: k-Nearest Neighbours
topics: Introduce distance metrics used by k-nearest neighbours.
Discuss how to choose k and its effect on bias and variance.
Give a first look at the curse of dimensionality for distance-based methods.

sessions.title: Lab Session 1
topics: Lab Session 1 - Implementing ML Algorithms on business problems (Regression/Classification)

sessions.title: Decision Trees 1
topics: Explain Gini and entropy as splitting criteria.
Grow decision trees from root to leaves.
Identify how trees overfit and why that matters.

sessions.title: Decision Trees 2
topics: Cover pruning as a control for tree complexity.
Handle categorical vs numeric features in tree splits.
Introduce feature importance from tree models.

sessions.title: Bagging & Random Forest
topics: Explain bootstrap aggregating (bagging) as an ensemble idea.
Build Random Forests and how random feature selection helps.

sessions.title: Boosting (GBM / XGBoost intro)
topics: Introduce AdaBoost and the gradient boosting idea.
Give a practical first look at XGBoost.
Cover basic tuning levers for boosting models.

sessions.title: Clustering (KMeans + hierarchical)
topics: Run KMeans with elbow and silhouette diagnostics.
Discuss when clustering is useful versus when it is not.

sessions.title: Dimensionality reduction (PCA)
topics: Explain variance explained by principal components.
Place PCA in a modeling pipeline with downstream estimators.
Show visualization and compression use cases.

sessions.title: Competition kickoff
topics: Introduce the competition dataset and primary evaluation metric.
Walk through an EDA checklist before modeling.
Set expectations for a strong baseline via outside-class submissions.

evaluations.component: For Internship Exempted & Course Repeat Students

sessions.title: MERN-1 : Intro to nodejs and Backend development
topics: Understand the role of Node.js in backend development. Learn about its event-driven architecture, modules, and how to set up a simple server using the http module.

sessions.title: MERN-3 : Intro to Mongodb and CRUD operation
topics: Learn how to connect Node.js applications to MongoDB using Mongoose. Implement full CRUD operations on a persistent NoSQL database.

sessions.title: MERN-4: MVC Architecture (Model View and Controllers)
topics: Understand the MVC pattern and apply it to structure backend code for better readability, scalability, and separation of concerns.

sessions.title: MERN-5: Project - Build a Social Media App-1 (Backend and Frontend Setup)
topics: Scaffold a full-stack MERN app. Set up the React frontend, Express backend, and prepare the environment for future feature integration.

sessions.title: MERN-6: Project - Build a Social Media App-2 (Connect to DB and create Models)
topics: Create MongoDB models for User and Post data. Establish a working DB connection and validate the data flow between backend and database.

sessions.title: MERN-7: Project - Build a Social Media App-3 (Authentication and Authorization with JWT )
topics: Implement secure authentication and authorization using JWT. Learn user registration, login flows, and protected routes.

sessions.title: MERN-8: Project - Build a Social Media App-4 (User Controllers , Middlewares and Cloudinary)
topics: Build reusable controller functions, apply custom middleware for validations and error handling, and integrate Cloudinary for profile image uploads.

sessions.title: MERN-9: Project - Build a Social Media App-5 (Implementing Posts API for Profile and UI)
topics: Develop APIs for creating, reading, and deleting posts. Integrate them with the frontend to render dynamic user feeds.

sessions.title: MERN-10: Project -Build a Social Media App-6 (Implementing Follow Unfollow Users and UI)
topics: Implement social graph features like follow/unfollow. Update UI to reflect changes and manage state based on user relationships.

sessions.title: MERN-11: Project - Build a Social Media App-7 (Implementing Like and comment API and UI)
topics: Add interactivity with like and comment APIs. Reflect real-time updates on the UI with proper feedback to users.

sessions.title: MERN-12: Project - Build a Social Media App-8 (Implementing Realtime Chat and Notifications with Socket.io)
topics: Introduce Socket.io to enable real-time messaging and notification features. Set up socket connections and user mapping.

sessions.title: MERN-13: Project - Build a Social Media App-9 (Implementing Realtime Chat and Notifications with Socket.io)-2
topics: Finalize chat and notification features with optimized socket events and frontend integration. Handle edge cases and message persistence.

sessions.title: MERN-14: Project - Build a Social Media App-10 (Optimizing the App for better performance)
topics: Improve app performance with lazy loading, code splitting, response caching, and frontend responsiveness tuning.

sessions.title: MERN-15: Project - Build a Social Media App-11( Adding Intelligence - Smart Captions with Gemini)
topics: Integrate Google Gemini API to generate intelligent captions for posts. Explore prompt engineering and API consumption within MERN stack.

sessions.title: MERN-16: Project - Build a Social Media App-12(Deployment of a Fullstack App)
topics: Deploy the complete app using platforms like Render, Vercel, or Railway. Configure environment variables and CI/CD basics.
